97.
(1) A  person  shall  not,  in  connection  with  an
application submitted to the Commission under this Part –

(a)
 make or procure the making of a statement to the
Commission which he knows or could reasonably
be expected to know is false or misleading; or

(b)
 omit to state any matter to the Commission where
he knows or could reasonably be expected to know
that  because  of  the  omission,  the  statement  is
misleading in a material respect.
